description: TownyMap Addon is a client-side EarthMC map extension for Xaero’s World Map and Xaero’s Minimap. It overlays EarthMC Towny data directly onto your in-game maps, making it much easier to read towns, nations, players, borders, claims, and useful Towny status information without leaving Minecraft.

mods.name: EarthMC Map Addon
mods.description: Overlays EarthMC Towny town borders and online players on Xaero's WorldMap.

releases.notes:
# 1.4.11

**Waypoints**
- Xaero's waypoints are visible on the world map again. With the Squaremap layer on, the EarthMC imagery painted straight over every marker on the map, so the addon now draws them back on top itself, at Xaero's own size and in Xaero's own colours. Hovering one still raises Xaero's tooltip and right-clicking one still opens Xaero's menu, because those were never covered.
- Right-clicking empty map opens Xaero's own menu again, so you can add a waypoint, teleport or share a location from the map. Right-clicking a town still opens the town panel; unclaimed ground is Xaero's, and so is any waypoint or tracked player under the cursor, so a waypoint standing inside a town can be edited, moved or deleted again. Settings -> World Map -> Wilderness Town Info puts the old behaviour back if you preferred it.
- Waypoints no longer disappear from the enlarged minimap, or on frames where the EarthMC layer drew nothing.
- On 1.21.11 only: your waypoints, the player arrow and the waypoint set name no longer show up on a map of a world you are not standing in, usually the Moon. The three hooks that suppress them named the method using the newer Minecraft versions' name for it, so on that build they had never once run.

**Nations**
- Every nation reported "No capital". The capital and king fields stopped being requested in 1.4.10, which took the capital stars, the "Capital of" tag, the capital circle in join range, the Capital and King rows and every nation jump with them.
- Searching a nation now goes to its capital, framed and flashed like any other town, instead of trying to fit the whole nation on screen.

**Ice highways**
- The ice highway network is built in, as mode 7 on the Map button. It is XiLeF2211's community-maintained map, fetched live so it stays current, and only downloaded once you switch the layer on.

**Fixes**
- A Moon outpost is no longer wiped out by an Earth claim refresh. Every Moon town shares a name with an Earth one, and the two were being confused: the Moon claim vanished and right-clicking it said wilderness.
- Leaving the map in Planning mode survives a restart. It silently came back as None every time.
- The chunk counter's Reset button sits beside the counter instead of a row above it.

**Search flash**
- A searched town now blinks its own border rather than tracing a second outline a pixel or two beside it, and it works again while a map mode is on. The freeze when the blink stopped is gone.

**Behind the scenes**
- The live player feed now reads EarthMC's new endpoint, which replaced the file the mod used to fetch. No visible difference, beyond it revalidating properly: most polls now transfer nothing instead of a few KB.

Available for Minecraft **1.21.11**, **26.1.x**, **26.2** and **26.3**.

mods.name: EarthMC Map Addon
mods.description: Overlays EarthMC Towny town borders and online players on Xaero's WorldMap.

releases.notes:
**Performance**
- The periodic stutter is gone. Working out which town owns each visible chunk used to land on one frame every so often; it now runs on a background thread while the previous view keeps drawing.
- Claim outlines draw as merged runs instead of one call per chunk side: a third to a fifth of the geometry in dense areas.

**Less data used**
- The EarthMC API is now asked for compressed responses, and only for the fields that are actually read. Opening the rankings went from 4.7 MB to 133 KB.
- Idle clients back off. Standing still with no map open drops roughly 37 MB an hour to about 6; moving resets it instantly. The wilderness alert is exempt, since idling is the state it exists for.
- The player feed polls slower when only the minimap is up, and not at all when nothing displays it.
- Claims now honour the polling interval the map server asks for, so EarthMC can slow every client down without waiting for a mod update. Requests also identify their version now.

**Search**
- Picking a result zooms to fit it instead of keeping whatever zoom you were already at, and flashes the claim it found so you can pick it out from its neighbours. Nations frame every member claim. Both can be turned off under World Map.

Available for Minecraft **1.21.11**, **26.1.x**, **26.2** and **26.3**.

mods.name: EarthMC Map Addon
mods.description: Overlays EarthMC Towny town borders and online players on Xaero's WorldMap.

releases.notes:
- Shop waypoints from /qs find now appear for every result. The parser insisted on wording QuickShop does not always print, so most shops were skipped in silence, and a slow search timed out before its results arrived.
- Fixed the mod sometimes sitting idle on EarthMC with every setting correct. A threading bug could latch the "is this EarthMC" check onto the wrong answer for the rest of the session.
- Planning mode reworked: the placement hint showed garbled text and hovering a chip did nothing. Hold shift to place a chain, escape to cancel, right-click a pin to remove it, and a new chip clears the plan. Counts and numbering update when a town is removed, and the markers and buttons now match the rest of the mod.
- New setting: Town Claims On Minimap, for hiding claims there without turning off the whole minimap overlay.
- The mod now says when it is idle because the server is not recognised as EarthMC, rather than drawing nothing with no explanation.
- Adding waypoints no longer flashes "default" across the minimap.
